question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Intterupt"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**Interrupt**".
 
• **Interrupt** means to stop the continuous progress of an activity or process. (विचलित करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to **interrupt **the meeting with an irrelevant question.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Experience** (अनुभव): Knowledge or skill that one gets from seeing and doing things.

 
 
• **Example:** She has five years of **experience **in software development.
 
 
 
• **Noticeable** (ध्यान देने योग्य): Easily seen or noticed; clear or apparent.
 
 
• **Example:** There was a **noticeable **change in his behaviour after the incident.
 
 
 
• **Commodity** (वस्तु): A raw material or primary agricultural product that can be bought and sold.
 
 
• **Example:** Oil is a valuable **commodity **in the global market.
